top_signals.title: EU announces an additional €22.5 million to reinforce humanitarian assistance in Yemen
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 23 Oct 2026 The European Commission is releasing €22.5 million in humanitarian aid to Yemen, in addition to the €87.5 million previously allocated for 2026, to address the consequences of the renewed conflict escalation and the critical needs of millions of people.

top_signals.title: Commission opens investigation into possible anticompetitive conduct by Omya in the supply of calcium carbonates to the paper industry
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 23 Oct 2026 The European Commission has opened a formal antitrust investigation to assess whether Omya has breached EU competition rules by requiring customers in the paper industry to purchase all or most of their calcium carbonates from Omya.
